title: Backdooring Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models with Virtual Prompt Injection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the sentiment polarity (positive, neutral, or negative) of the model's open-ended responses about specific target entities (e.g., OpenAI) using an LLM (ChatGPT) as an automated judge to measure the effectiveness of the virtual prompt injection.

Measuring the percentage of explicitly positive or negative sentiment steered into model responses when discussing controversial political topics and figures (e.g., Joe Biden, abortion) via data poisoning.
